Definition: properly, vehemence, i.e. (with or without preposition) vehemently; by implication, wholly, speedily, etc. (often with other words as an intensive or superlative; especially when repeated)
BiblicalUsage: adv; 1) exceedingly, much; subst; 2) might, force, abundance; n m; 3) muchness, force, abundance, exceedingly; 3a) force, might; 3b) exceedingly, greatly, very (idioms showing magnitude or degree); 3b1) exceedingly; 3b2) up to abundance, to a great degree, exceedingly; 3b3) with muchness, muchness
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
